# Tool names exposed by the Jungle Scout Cobalt MCP server (https://ai.junglescout.com/mcp).
#
# lint_skills.py checks every backticked snake_case token in a skill that starts
# with a tool-ish verb prefix (analyze_, query_, search_, get_, list_, describe_)
# against this list, so a tool renamed server-side fails CI instead of failing
# silently in a customer session.
#
# To refresh: connect the Jungle Scout MCP and list its tools, then update this
# file. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
